The symmetric star characteristic polynomial is X(X−u)^(m−2)[X²−(2w+mu)X+(m+1)wu]. Reparameterization z=λ−/u leads to derivative sign (m−1)[(m+1−2z)²−t z²], yielding threshold √t=m−1. Below threshold rates are all 1/(m−1+t). Above: h=√t, B=m t+2(m−1)(h+1), w=[m(h+1)−1]/(hB), u=(h+2)/B, gap=(m+1)/B. Global uniqueness beyond symmetric optimum uses Fiedler eigenvector equality for above threshold and orthogonal leaf-vs-exception PSD contrast vectors for below threshold. Independently computed numerical eigenvalues and budgets for (m,t)=(3,9),(5,5),(5,25),(7,36),(7,37), matching formula. Boundary zero-weight star disconnects.
